title: We tried everything to make him look up
idea: Never Looks Up S2 E1: everything fails to make him look up; one text from 1 m away works, and the show is over

hook.what: the Wizard yells into a megaphone at Phoenix's ear; Phoenix only sees his phone

props.staged: lying on its side on the paving under the bench
a puff of flame in the air
the sent text, flying between the phones
in the Wizard's robe until he takes it out

do.reason: the megaphone squeals into Phoenix's ear
the pigeons burst off the paving
car alarms going off across the city
the Wizard drops onto the bench
a chat bubble flying into his phone, not a falling body

visible.why: 01: the promise, the megaphone at Phoenix's ear, the band and the rockets ready
02: the Wizard can't believe it, then 'fine'
03: the band blasting right at him; he scrolls
04: the Dragon puffs a flame at the fuse; the rockets go
04a: LOOK UP over the skyline, the bench small below
05: he gives up, sits and texts
05-06: the text flies 1 m into Phoenix's phone
06: the ping; Phoenix looks up at him and waves
07: he points at the sky; only sparks are left
07: Reaper cracks up; Phoenix back on his phone; the Wizard face-down

allowClip.reason: the Wizard stands on the bench seat (01-02)
the Wizard sits on the bench (05-07)
the Dragon stands on the bench seat with the tuba (03)
across the 8.4 s cut (06 close two-shot to 07 wide): his waving hand is back on the phone in the new shot, no turn inside a shot
a 6 mm conductor's baton pinched at its cork, 8 m from the camera in 03 and off screen in 04: a few pixels wide
the 6 mm baton shifts 3 cm in his pinch on the first downbeat, 8 m from the camera in the wide 03: about 3 px at full size
